description: This file defines the ACLJSController class, which manages access control logic and generates JavaScript snippets to enforce ACL permissions on the client-side within the SuiteCRM system. It handles rendering scripts for disabling form elements based on user permissions and supports dynamic retrieval of HTML attributes for access control.

classes.name: ACLJSController
classes.description: Manages ACL-related JavaScript generation and HTML attribute fetching for module forms, based on user permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller with module-specific parameters.

methods.name: getJavascript
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to disable form elements based on user permissions and module ACL settings.

methods.name: getHTMLValues
methods.description: Returns HTML attributes for form elements based on display option configurations.

methods.name: getFieldByIdScript
methods.description: Creates JavaScript to disable or modify DOM elements identified by ID based on ACL checks.

methods.name: getFieldByNameScript
methods.description: Creates JavaScript to modify elements identified by name attribute based on ACL checks.

methods.name: getFieldByFormScript
methods.description: Creates JavaScript to modify form elements within a specific form based on ACL checks.
